useful_god.rationale: Day Master Wood is weak; Water balances the chart.

errors.message: House system 'placidus' is undefined at latitude 69.6492. Beyond the polar circles the diurnal arc does not divide; use house_system='whole_sign', which is defined at every latitude.

yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in the 12th sign from the Moon; Gaja-Kesari needs the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th.

yogas.name: Budha-Aditya
yogas.reason: Sun and Mercury are both in Gemini.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala
yogas.reason: Moon is in Virgo and Mars in Leo; Chandra-Mangala needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Ruchaka
yogas.reason: Mars is in Leo, neither its own sign (Aries, Scorpio) nor its exaltation sign (Capricorn).

yogas.name: Bhadra
yogas.reason: Mercury is in its own sign Gemini and in the 10th house from the Lagna, a kendra.

yogas.name: Hamsa
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in Leo, neither its own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces) nor its exaltation sign (Cancer).

yogas.name: Malavya
yogas.reason: Venus is in its own sign Taurus but in the 9th house from the Lagna; Malavya needs a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house).

yogas.name: Sasa
yogas.reason: Saturn is in Leo, neither its own sign (Capricorn, Aquarius) nor its exaltation sign (Libra).

yogas.name: Harsha
yogas.reason: The 6th house is Aquarius; its lord Saturn is in the 12th house.

yogas.name: Sarala
yogas.reason: The 8th house is Aries; its lord Mars is in the 12th house.

yogas.name: Vimala
yogas.reason: The 12th house is Leo; its lord Sun is in the 10th house; Vimala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga
yogas.reason: No planet is in its debilitation sign.

yogas.name: Sunapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Libra): none; 12th from the Moon (Leo): Mars, Jupiter and Saturn (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Anapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Libra): none; 12th from the Moon (Leo): Mars, Jupiter and Saturn (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Durudhara
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Libra): none; 12th from the Moon (Leo): Mars, Jupiter and Saturn (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Kemadruma
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Libra): none; 12th from the Moon (Leo): Mars, Jupiter and Saturn (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count); Kemadruma means both are empty.

yogas.name: Vesi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Cancer): none; 12th from the Sun (Taurus): Venus (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Vasi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Cancer): none; 12th from the Sun (Taurus): Venus (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Cancer): none; 12th from the Sun (Taurus): Venus (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Subha Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: Jupiter. Subha Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Papa Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: Mars and Saturn. Papa Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Parivartana
yogas.reason: No two planets stand in each other's signs.

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha
yogas.reason: Mars is 12th from the Lagna, 12th from the Moon and 4th from Venus; the dosha houses are the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th.

yogas.name: Kala Sarpa
yogas.reason: Planets lie on both sides of the Rahu–Ketu axis: Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn on one, Sun, Mercury and Venus on the other.

yogas.name: Amala
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th from the Lagna (Gemini): Mercury; in the 10th from the Moon (Gemini): Mercury.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: Lords of the 2nd, 5th, 9th and 11th (2nd Venus, 5th Saturn, 9th Venus, 11th Moon) share no sign, mutual aspect or sign exchange.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Venus (Taurus) and the 10th lord Mercury (Gemini) share no sign, mutual aspect or sign exchange.

yogas.name: Nakshatra Parivartana
yogas.reason: Mars is in a nakshatra ruled by Venus and Venus in one ruled by Mars.
